$description: diarie design tokens — W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft format. Generated to mirror tokens.css; if the two disagree, tokens.css wins.

palette.$description: Raw named colors. Swedish names, ASCII-folded; glossary in BRAND.md.

arkiv.$description: The archive after closing. Page ground.

papper-2.$description: The sheet lifted one step: cards and specimen panels on papper. 16.01:1 vs text in a paper context.

hektograf.$description: Copy-ink violet. Large type/borders on arkiv (3.13:1); body text on papper (4.73:1).

hektograf-ljus.$description: Muted text on dark. 6.29:1 on arkiv.

lavendel.$description: Secondary text on dark. 8.63:1 on arkiv.

lavendel-ljus.$description: Selection wash on paper. Not derived from papper — a tint toward white, not toward the cream. 12.34:1 vs text in a paper context.

stampel.$description: Stamp-pad red (stämpel). Large type and stamps on arkiv only (4.23:1).

stampel-ljus.$description: Red at body size on dark. 6.28:1 on arkiv.

stampel-mork.$description: Red at body size on papper. 5.19:1.

stampel-blek.$description: Stämpel on paper: card ground. 1.06:1 on papper. A ground only — the meaning must live in the label, not the tint.

stampel-dov.$description: Stämpel on paper: card edge. 1.92:1 on papper, 1.81:1 on stampel-blek — decorative, below the 3:1 non-text floor, so it never carries state alone.

blad-blek.$description: Herbarium green, palest step: card grounds on papper. 1.04:1.

blad-ljus.$description: Herbarium green, card borders. 1.66:1 on papper — never text. Why blad is a separate family from fosfor, with sources: DESIGN.md § Colors.

blad.$description: Herbarium green, the dashed specimen mark. 3.26:1 on papper, 3.40:1 on blad-blek — clears the 3:1 non-text floor, borders only.

blad-mork.$description: Herbarium green, ink on the sheet. 6.51:1 on papper, 6.80:1 on blad-blek, 7.05:1 on papper-2. The green counterpart of stampel-mork; a separate family from fosfor, which is emitted terminal phosphor and 1.30:1 on papper.

kant.$description: Hairline border on the dark ground. tokens.css expresses this as color-mix(in srgb, var(--papper) 16%, transparent) — numerically identical, since papper is #EFE6D2.

fosfor-p3.$description: Wide-gamut fosfor: chroma-boosted, same lightness and hue so contrast holds. Serve only under @media (color-gamut: p3) + @supports oklch — the gate itself is CSS-only (tokens.css).

barnsten-p3.$description: Wide-gamut bärnsten. Same gate as fosfor-p3.

stampel-p3.$description: Wide-gamut stämpel. Same gate as fosfor-p3.

stampel-ljus-p3.$description: Wide-gamut stämpel-ljus. Same gate as fosfor-p3.

lysning-4-p3.$description: Wide-gamut innermost halo step. Same gate as fosfor-p3.

1.$description: You asked wrong: ENOSTORE, EUSAGE, EEXIST, ETWOSTORES, ELEGACY, ELOSSY.

2.$description: It ran, and the answer is no. The stamp belongs to validate.

arkiv.$description: The archive voice: what the human wrote.

lasare.$description: The reader voice: what the CLI reports.

korn.$description: Riso grain opacity ceiling. Static, never animated.

markering.$description: The marker wash: hektograf at highlighter strength. At most three per page.

ease-lysning.$description: The light coming up on the table. The only easing.
